Method of Attack: Allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code using a specially prepared archive file with the RAR extension
Exploitation requires user interaction by opening a malicious archive
Attackers can organize botnets, steal personal files, block the system, encrypt valuable data, and execute ransomware attacks
Attack Vector: Opening a malicious RAR archive generated by attackers
Indicators of Compromise: RAR archive files from untrusted sources
Compressed files in emails from unknown recipients
